gaps.quote: the ring obtained by identifying two polynomials
gaps.note: A ring (a set with addition and multiplication obeying the ring axioms) is not in the reader profile and the page neither explains nor links it. The page relies on it for the operations on the quotient, which are stated to form a ring.

gaps.quote: so every class contains exactly one polynomial of that degree
gaps.note: Existence of a representative of degree less than r follows from division by the monic polynomial y^r+1, which the reader may accept. Uniqueness needs that a nonzero multiple of y^r+1 has degree at least r, which the page never states. The page also does not argue that multiplication in the quotient agrees with the multiplication of the named polynomial ring.
